entries.en: An informational leaflet explains which items belong in each recycling bin.
entries.zh: 一份说明传单解释了各类垃圾应该放进哪个回收箱。

entries.en: The two churches separated after a lengthy doctrinal dispute.
entries.zh: 这两个教会在长期的教义争论后分开了。

entries.en: Although ideologically opposed, the candidates agreed that the library needed repairs.
entries.zh: 尽管在意识形态上对立，两位候选人都同意图书馆需要修缮。

entries.en: The forecaster warned of strong winds along the coast overnight.
entries.zh: 天气预报员提醒，沿海地区夜间将有强风。

entries.en: After the large meal, a feeling of fullness kept him awake.
entries.zh: 吃过那顿大餐后，饱胀感让他睡不着。

entries.meaningZh: 有罪的；违背宗教戒律的
entries.en: The preacher described deliberate cruelty as sinful in his sermon.
entries.zh: 传教士在布道中说，故意残忍待人是违背宗教戒律的。

entries.en: The lite version offers basic editing tools but excludes animation features.
entries.zh: 简化版提供基本编辑工具，但不含动画功能。

entries.en: A narrow dirt track separates the cornfield from the orchard.
entries.zh: 一条狭窄的土路把玉米田和果园隔开。

entries.en: Accusations of partisanship damaged the committee's reputation for fairness.
entries.zh: 偏袒党派的指控损害了委员会公正的声誉。

entries.en: The hiking trail climbs through a densely forested valley.
entries.zh: 这条徒步小径穿过森林茂密的山谷，向上延伸。

entries.en: She rolled the fondant thinly before covering the birthday cake.
entries.zh: 她先把糖膏擀薄，再盖在生日蛋糕上。

entries.en: The newlyweds spent their first weekend together painting their apartment.
entries.zh: 这对新婚夫妇一起粉刷公寓，度过了婚后的第一个周末。

entries.en: We shared a slice of cheesecake topped with fresh raspberries.
entries.zh: 我们分吃了一块点缀着新鲜覆盆子的芝士蛋糕。

entries.en: As a homemaker, he manages the household while his wife works.
entries.zh: 作为料理家庭的人，他在妻子上班时负责家务。

entries.en: The decorator covered the furniture before painting the living room.
entries.zh: 装修工先盖好家具，再粉刷客厅。

entries.en: Our geography class compared rainfall patterns in equatorial and polar regions.
entries.zh: 我们的地理课比较了赤道地区和极地的降雨规律。

entries.en: The farmer called the newborn goat a lively little critter.
entries.zh: 农场主把那只刚出生的小山羊称为活泼的小家伙。

entries.en: The course combines classroom discussion with experiential learning on a working farm.
entries.zh: 这门课把课堂讨论与实际运营农场里的体验式学习结合起来。

entries.en: A toothpick held the layers of the small sandwich together.
entries.zh: 一根牙签把小三明治的各层固定在一起。

entries.en: The driver blatantly ignored the sign and parked across the entrance.
entries.zh: 那名司机公然无视标志，把车停在入口处挡住了通道。

entries.en: Their agreement relies on reciprocity: each group shares equipment with the other.
entries.zh: 他们的协议建立在互惠基础上：双方相互共享设备。

entries.en: The teacher underlined the predicate and circled the subject in each sentence.
entries.zh: 老师给每句的谓语部分画了下划线，并圈出了主语。

entries.en: "Oops, I sent you yesterday's schedule by mistake," Leo said.
entries.zh: “哎呀，我错把昨天的日程表发给你了，”利奥说。

entries.en: The neurologist asked her to describe when the headaches first appeared.
entries.zh: 神经科医生请她描述头痛最早是什么时候出现的。

entries.en: The new assistant handled an unexpected rush of customers admirably.
entries.zh: 新来的店员出色地应对了突然涌来的顾客。

entries.en: Regrettably, the only surviving photograph is too damaged to display.
entries.zh: 遗憾的是，唯一留存的照片破损过于严重，无法展出。

entries.en: The seminar used dialectic to examine two opposing accounts of freedom.
entries.zh: 研讨课运用辩证法审视了两种对立的自由观。

entries.en: For the composer, music offered a sense of transcendence beyond everyday concerns.
entries.zh: 对这位作曲家而言，音乐带来了一种超越日常烦忧的感受。

entries.en: Her parents wholeheartedly supported her decision to train as a carpenter.
entries.zh: 她的父母全心全意支持她学习木工的决定。

entries.en: They loaded supplies onto a snowmobile before crossing the frozen landscape.
entries.zh: 他们把补给品装上雪地摩托，随后穿越冰封的原野。

entries.en: The claim was patently false: the supposedly empty room was full of people.
entries.zh: 这个说法显然不实：那间据称空着的房间里挤满了人。

entries.en: A pluralistic society makes room for people with different beliefs and traditions.
entries.zh: 多元社会为持有不同信仰和传统的人们提供空间。

entries.en: The competition's age limit was rigorously enforced at registration.
entries.zh: 报名时严格执行了比赛的年龄限制。

entries.en: Visitors were asked to respect the sanctity of the small chapel.
entries.zh: 参观者被要求尊重这座小礼拜堂的神圣性。

entries.en: We found our class photograph near the back of the yearbook.
entries.zh: 我们在毕业纪念册靠后的地方找到了班级合影。

entries.en: Rain fell intermittently throughout the match, sending spectators under the awning.
entries.zh: 比赛期间雨断断续续地下，观众纷纷躲到雨篷下。

entries.en: The stone foundations predate the wooden house by several centuries.
entries.zh: 这些石地基比上面的木屋早了几个世纪。

entries.en: Someone had crudely repaired the fence with mismatched boards and bent nails.
entries.zh: 有人用不配套的木板和弯钉粗粗修补了围栏。

entries.en: The editor removed the profanity before publishing the interview in the school magazine.
entries.zh: 编辑删去脏话后，才把这篇访谈刊登在校刊上。

entries.en: The two complaints concerned unconnected incidents on different bus routes.
entries.zh: 这两项投诉涉及不同公交线路上互不相关的事件。

entries.en: The costume designer used liquid latex to make flexible monster masks.
entries.zh: 服装设计师用液态乳胶制作柔韧的怪兽面具。

entries.en: The graph shows a nonlinear relationship, with growth slowing as the input increases.
entries.zh: 图中呈现出非线性关系：随着输入增加，增长逐渐放缓。

entries.en: The documentary follows families who campaigned for the desegregation of local schools.
entries.zh: 这部纪录片记录了争取当地学校废除种族隔离的家庭。

entries.en: The revised handbook covers the equipment's operation more comprehensively than the old one.
entries.zh: 新版手册对设备操作的介绍比旧版更全面。

entries.en: The bartender measured the tequila before adding lime juice and ice.
entries.zh: 调酒师量好龙舌兰酒，再加入青柠汁和冰块。

entries.en: She waited for the oncoming traffic to pass before turning right.
entries.zh: 她等迎面车辆通过后才右转。

entries.en: Heavy snowfall overnight buried the garden steps and blocked the lane.
entries.zh: 夜间的大雪埋住了花园台阶，也堵住了小巷。

entries.en: The salad gets its crunchy texture from thin slices of raw carrot.
entries.zh: 这份沙拉的脆爽口感来自薄薄的生胡萝卜片。

entries.en: After losing the sketchbook, she began the entire design afresh.
entries.zh: 丢失速写本后，她把整个设计重新做了一遍。

entries.en: A gloved hand reached through the hatch to collect our tickets.
entries.zh: 一只戴着手套的手从小窗口伸出来收票。

entries.en: Check the kitchen rota to see who is cooking tonight.
entries.zh: 看看厨房轮值表，就知道今晚轮到谁做饭。

entries.en: The photograph was too blurry for us to read the street sign.
entries.zh: 照片太模糊，我们看不清路牌上的字。

entries.en: Little Clara sent a birthday card to her namesake, her grandmother.
entries.zh: 小克拉拉给与她同名的祖母寄了一张生日贺卡。

entries.en: The panel questioned the appropriateness of using cartoons in a serious memorial.
entries.zh: 评审组质疑在严肃的纪念活动中使用漫画是否合适。

entries.meaningZh: 重新解释既有历史观点的
entries.en: Her revisionist account challenges the familiar story of the town's founding.
entries.zh: 她对历史的重新解读挑战了人们熟悉的建镇说法。

entries.en: He stirred buttermilk into the batter before heating the frying pan.
entries.zh: 他把酪乳拌入面糊，然后加热煎锅。

entries.en: The receptionist directed each enquirer to the appropriate department.
entries.zh: 接待员把每位询问者引导到相应的部门。

entries.en: The handwritten diary gives the story an immediacy that a later summary lacks.
entries.zh: 手写日记为这个故事带来了一种事后概述所没有的真切感。

entries.en: The gallery placed a notice about nudity at the exhibition entrance.
entries.zh: 画廊在展览入口处放置了有关裸体内容的提示。

entries.en: Seeing the repaired clock work again was especially gratifying for the apprentice.
entries.zh: 看到修好的钟再次走动，学徒格外欣慰。

entries.en: The novel's opening hints at the inevitability of the brothers' final confrontation.
entries.zh: 小说开头暗示，两兄弟最后的对峙不可避免。

entries.en: The discussion focused on emergent trends in independent game design.
entries.zh: 讨论集中在独立游戏设计中新出现的趋势。

entries.en: She painstakingly numbered every fragment before attempting to rebuild the vase.
entries.zh: 她先一丝不苟地给每块碎片编号，再尝试修复花瓶。

entries.en: He spoke eloquently about the importance of preserving his grandmother's language.
entries.zh: 他富有感染力地讲述了保留祖母语言的重要性。

entries.en: The townspeople gathered in the square to welcome the returning rowing team.
entries.zh: 镇上的居民聚集在广场，迎接归来的赛艇队。

entries.en: He habitually checks the lock twice before leaving the workshop.
entries.zh: 离开工坊前，他习惯性地检查两次门锁。

entries.en: The replacement parts arrived speedily, allowing the bakery to reopen on Monday.
entries.zh: 替换零件迅速送达，让面包店得以在周一重新营业。

entries.en: The rider wiped rain from her helmet's visor at the next stop.
entries.zh: 骑手在下一站擦掉了头盔面罩上的雨水。

entries.en: A wooden boardwalk keeps visitors above the marsh's muddy ground.
entries.zh: 木板步道让游客不用踩进沼泽的泥地。

entries.en: The new room is undeniably brighter, although it offers less storage.
entries.zh: 新房间无疑更明亮，不过储物空间较少。

entries.en: The incoming tide moved inexorably toward the children's unfinished sandcastle.
entries.zh: 涨潮的海水不可阻挡地向孩子们尚未完工的沙堡逼近。

entries.meaningZh: 水流侵蚀形成的岩石壶穴
entries.en: The guide pointed to a deep pothole worn into the riverbed rock.
entries.zh: 向导指着河床岩石上被水流磨出的一个深壶穴。

entries.en: The explorers searched the mountains for a fabled city of gold.
entries.zh: 探险者在群山中寻找传说中的黄金城。

entries.en: Please state the problem succinctly before suggesting possible solutions.
entries.zh: 请先简洁地说明问题，再提出可能的解决办法。

entries.en: A short branch track connects the factory to the mainline.
entries.zh: 一段短支线把工厂与铁路干线连接起来。

entries.en: The students studied counterpoint by combining two independent melodies at the piano.
entries.zh: 学生们在钢琴上把两条独立旋律结合起来，学习音乐对位法。

entries.en: She trained as a potter but has latterly concentrated on making glassware.
entries.zh: 她受过陶艺训练，但近来专注于制作玻璃器皿。

entries.en: The report presents changes in attendance graphically, using a separate line for each class.
entries.zh: 报告以图表呈现出勤变化，每个班级各用一条线表示。

entries.en: The staff's friendliness made the unfamiliar hostel feel welcoming.
entries.zh: 工作人员的友善让这家陌生旅舍显得亲切宜人。

entries.en: An empty hammock swayed between two trees behind the cottage.
entries.zh: 小屋后面，一张空吊床在两棵树之间摇晃。

entries.en: The water level rose alarmingly close to the bottom of the bridge.
entries.zh: 水位涨得几乎碰到桥底，令人担忧。

entries.en: The visualization uses darker colors to show areas with more recorded sightings.
entries.zh: 这幅可视化图用较深的颜色显示目击记录更多的地区。

entries.en: Astonishingly, the missing ring was inside a shoe nobody had worn for months.
entries.zh: 令人惊讶的是，丢失的戒指竟在一只几个月没人穿过的鞋里。

entries.en: We hoped to reach the campsite before nightfall hid the trail.
entries.zh: 我们希望在夜幕遮住小路前赶到营地。

entries.en: The parcel was inadequately packed, and two bowls arrived broken.
entries.zh: 包裹包装不够妥善，送到时有两个碗碎了。

entries.en: The old film has a grainy texture that suits its winter scenes.
entries.zh: 这部老电影带有颗粒感的画面质感很适合其中的冬日场景。

entries.en: She added a small balcony as an afterthought to the original design.
entries.zh: 她后来想到在原设计上补加一个小阳台。

entries.en: The manager is answerable to the board for the department's spending.
entries.zh: 经理须就部门开支向董事会负责。

entries.en: The new director ruthlessly removed every scene that slowed the play.
entries.zh: 新导演毫不留情地删掉了所有拖慢戏剧节奏的场景。

entries.en: The lanky teenager folded himself awkwardly into the tiny back seat.
entries.zh: 那个瘦高的少年别扭地蜷着身子，挤进了狭小的后座。

entries.en: The essay compares different religious beliefs about the afterlife.
entries.zh: 这篇文章比较了不同宗教关于来世的信仰。

entries.en: The florist suggested white tulips for the narrow glass vase.
entries.zh: 花店老板建议用白色郁金香搭配那个细长的玻璃花瓶。

entries.en: His apology was singularly unconvincing because he continued laughing throughout it.
entries.zh: 他的道歉极其难以让人信服，因为他从头到尾一直在笑。

entries.en: The audience watched passively until the presenter invited questions.
entries.zh: 观众一直被动地看着，直到主讲人邀请大家提问。

entries.en: She carries her lacrosse stick to practice every Wednesday afternoon.
entries.zh: 她每周三下午都带着长曲棍球球杆去训练。

entries.en: The table was absurdly large for a kitchen barely wider than the doorway.
entries.zh: 厨房只比门口宽一点，这张桌子放在里面大得离谱。

entries.en: His increasing frailty made the steep garden steps difficult to manage.
entries.zh: 他身体越来越虚弱，走花园里陡峭的台阶变得困难。

entries.en: Careful measurements reduced timber wastage during the construction of the shelves.
entries.zh: 仔细测量减少了制作书架时的木材浪费。

entries.en: Dry leaves crackled underfoot as we crossed the empty playground.
entries.zh: 我们走过空荡荡的操场时，干树叶在脚下沙沙作响。

entries.en: She walked purposefully toward the desk, carrying the missing application form.
entries.zh: 她拿着那份遗失的申请表，径直走向办公桌。

entries.en: The committee assessed whether the proposed building materials were ecologically sound.
entries.zh: 委员会评估了拟用建筑材料在生态方面是否合理。

entries.en: The ferocity of the storm surprised even the experienced boat crew.
entries.zh: 风暴的猛烈程度连经验丰富的船员也感到意外。

entries.en: In the crime novel, the shopkeeper reports an attempt at extortion.
entries.zh: 在这部犯罪小说中，店主报案称有人企图敲诈勒索。

entries.en: The volunteers were justifiably proud of restoring the neglected garden.
entries.zh: 志愿者为修复了荒废的花园而自豪，这是理所当然的。

entries.en: A small inaccuracy in the map sent us down the wrong street.
entries.zh: 地图上的一处小错误让我们走错了街。

entries.en: The captain's exhortation to remain calm steadied the inexperienced crew.
entries.zh: 船长恳切地劝大家保持冷静，让缺乏经验的船员稳住了心神。

entries.en: The archive uses a simple taxonomy to group letters by topic.
entries.zh: 档案馆使用一种简单的分类体系，按主题把信件归类。

entries.en: A moment of carelessness left a large ink stain on the drawing.
entries.zh: 一时粗心，让图画上留下了一大块墨渍。

entries.en: The picnic basket was amply supplied with sandwiches, fruit, and drinking water.
entries.zh: 野餐篮里备足了三明治、水果和饮用水。

entries.en: The exhibition examines the sociopolitical changes that reshaped the port district.
entries.zh: 展览探讨了改变港口街区面貌的社会政治变迁。

entries.en: "This goddamned printer has jammed again," he muttered, pulling out the paper.
entries.zh: “这该死的打印机又卡纸了，”他一边抽出纸张一边嘟囔。

entries.en: The bus runs so infrequently that we usually walk to the station.
entries.zh: 公交车班次太少，我们通常步行去车站。

entries.en: In the final chapter, the messenger is fatally wounded before delivering the letter.
entries.zh: 最后一章里，信使还没送出信，就受了致命伤。

entries.en: She checked the figures on the printout against the original spreadsheet.
entries.zh: 她把打印件上的数字与原始电子表格逐一核对。

entries.en: His early excitement about the job gradually gave way to disillusionment.
entries.zh: 他起初对这份工作兴奋不已，后来却渐渐幻想破灭，感到失望。

entries.en: The owner categorically denied that the house was for sale.
entries.zh: 房主明确而坚决地否认这栋房子正在出售。

entries.en: He grudgingly admitted that his younger sister had solved the puzzle first.
entries.zh: 他不情愿地承认，是妹妹先解开了谜题。

entries.en: The landlord seemed unsympathetic when we explained why the rent was late.
entries.zh: 我们解释房租迟交的原因时，房东似乎并不同情。

entries.en: Three small pots of basil stood on the sunny kitchen windowsill.
entries.zh: 三小盆罗勒摆在阳光充足的厨房窗台上。

entries.en: The experienced translator was handsomely paid for completing the difficult manuscript.
entries.zh: 那位经验丰富的译者完成了这份难译的手稿，获得了优厚报酬。

entries.en: A nameless traveler arrives at the inn in the opening scene.
entries.zh: 开场时，一位没有名字的旅人来到了客栈。

entries.en: The philosophy class debated whether moral relativism leaves room for universal standards.
entries.zh: 哲学课讨论了道德相对主义是否仍容许普遍标准存在。

entries.en: The box was manifestly too small to hold all the equipment.
entries.zh: 这个箱子显然太小，装不下所有设备。

entries.en: Moving the desk did not materially improve access to the shelves.
entries.zh: 挪动办公桌并没有明显改善取用书架物品的便利程度。

entries.en: Her bright yellow suitcase stood conspicuously among the black bags.
entries.zh: 她鲜黄色的行李箱在一堆黑包中格外显眼。

entries.en: The members decided democratically which project would receive the remaining funds.
entries.zh: 成员们以民主方式决定，把剩余资金分给哪个项目。

entries.en: The botanical drawing shows buds clustered terminally on each stem.
entries.zh: 植物图中，每根茎的芽都聚集在顶端。

entries.en: The ball flew deep into the outfield, beyond the nearest fielder.
entries.zh: 球飞向外场深处，越过了最近那名防守球员。

entries.en: The upshot of our discussion was that nobody wanted to move offices.
entries.zh: 我们讨论的最终结果是，谁都不想搬办公室。

entries.en: We used the waiting time profitably by reviewing tomorrow's interview questions.
entries.zh: 我们利用等待时间复习了明天面试的问题，没有白等。

entries.en: The amateur actors performed splendidly despite having only three weeks to rehearse.
entries.zh: 尽管只有三周排练时间，业余演员们还是演得非常出色。

entries.en: The astronaut waited inside the airlock before opening the outer hatch.
entries.zh: 宇航员先在气闸舱内等待，然后打开外舱门。

entries.en: She stood petrified as the huge dog blocked the narrow doorway.
entries.zh: 巨犬挡住狭窄的门口时，她吓得站着一动不动。

entries.en: The lightness of the folding chair makes it easy to carry uphill.
entries.zh: 折叠椅很轻，背着上坡也方便。

entries.en: In the old cottage, he slept on a straw pallet beside the stove.
entries.zh: 在那间旧小屋里，他睡在炉子旁的简陋草铺上。

entries.en: From the boat, we watched a gator slide into the dark water.
entries.zh: 我们在船上看着一条短吻鳄滑入幽暗的水中。

entries.en: The folders were numbered arbitrarily, without reference to their contents or dates.
entries.zh: 这些文件夹是随意编号的，与内容和日期无关。

entries.en: A thatched cottage stood at the end of the winding lane.
entries.zh: 一间茅草顶小屋坐落在蜿蜒小巷的尽头。

entries.en: The puppy playfully tugged at the blanket until it fell off the sofa.
entries.zh: 小狗闹着玩地拉扯毯子，直到把它从沙发上拽了下来。

entries.en: Once everyone had calmed down, we could discuss the problem rationally.
entries.zh: 大家冷静下来后，我们就能理性地讨论问题了。

entries.en: Her father's admonition to check the weather returned to her as thunder sounded.
entries.zh: 雷声响起时，她想起父亲要她查看天气的告诫。

entries.en: He belatedly realized that the invitation had given last week's date.
entries.zh: 他很晚才意识到，邀请函上的日期是上个星期。

entries.en: At the fork, a faded signpost pointed toward the abandoned mill.
entries.zh: 岔路口一个褪色的路标指向那座废弃磨坊。

entries.en: A broken streetlight left the bus stop in complete darkness.
entries.zh: 一盏坏掉的路灯让公交站陷入一片漆黑。

entries.en: The twins were distinguishable only by the different colors of their scarves.
entries.zh: 只有围巾颜色不同，才让人能分清这对双胞胎。

entries.meaningZh: 不善交际的书呆子（非正式）
entries.en: The novel's awkward young nerd feels more comfortable in libraries than at parties.
entries.zh: 小说中那个不善交际的年轻书呆子在图书馆里比在聚会上更自在。

entries.en: A coffee aficionado, my uncle weighs the beans before every brew.
entries.zh: 叔叔是个咖啡迷，每次冲泡前都要称咖啡豆。

entries.en: The drone's payload included a camera and two small measuring instruments.
entries.zh: 这架无人机的有效载荷包括一台相机和两个小型测量仪器。

entries.en: Her grandfather affectionately called her his little chief engineer.
entries.zh: 祖父亲昵地称她为自己的小总工程师。

entries.en: The committee stated unequivocally that the original agreement still applied.
entries.zh: 委员会明确表示，原协议依然适用。

entries.en: The undeveloped land behind the station became a temporary community garden.
entries.zh: 车站后面尚未开发的土地成了临时社区花园。

entries.en: The old novel describes its unmarried schoolteacher as a spinster.
entries.zh: 这部旧小说把未婚女教师称作老姑娘。

entries.en: Several readers found the cartoon objectionable and wrote to the editor.
entries.zh: 几位读者觉得那幅漫画令人反感，便给编辑写了信。

entries.en: To add these fractions, first give them the same denominator.
entries.zh: 要把这些分数相加，先把它们通分。

entries.en: We timed each oscillation of the pendulum with a stopwatch.
entries.zh: 我们用秒表测量钟摆每次摆动的时间。

entries.en: After months of inactivity, the workshop was filled with noise again.
entries.zh: 闲置数月之后，工坊里再次响起忙碌的声音。

entries.en: The deformed metal bracket no longer fitted into the door frame.
entries.zh: 变形的金属支架再也装不进门框了。

entries.en: He dunked his biscuit in the tea and quickly pulled it out.
entries.zh: 他把饼干在茶里蘸了一下，很快就拿出来了。

entries.en: The widower continued growing the roses his wife had planted.
entries.zh: 那位丧妻的男子继续照料妻子种下的玫瑰。

entries.en: She answered truthfully when the interviewer asked about her previous experience.
entries.zh: 面试官问到以往经历时，她如实回答了。

entries.en: The fragile plates were wrapped singly before being packed into the box.
entries.zh: 易碎的盘子逐个包好后，才被装进箱子。

entries.en: The carpenter tested the sharpness of the blade on a scrap of wood.
entries.zh: 木匠在一块废木料上试了试刀刃的锋利程度。

entries.en: The lecturer explained the religious iconography of the birds in the painting.
entries.zh: 讲师解释了画中鸟类图像的宗教象征含义。

entries.en: A local philanthropist donated the building for use as a youth center.
entries.zh: 一位当地慈善家捐出这栋建筑，用作青年活动中心。

entries.en: When two workers requested the same holiday dates, seniority decided the matter.
entries.zh: 两名员工申请同一时段休假时，资历成了决定因素。

entries.en: The researchers looked for commonality among accounts from different villages.
entries.zh: 研究者寻找不同村庄的叙述之间的共同点。

entries.en: Short stubble covered the field after the wheat harvest was finished.
entries.zh: 小麦收割完后，田里满是短短的麦茬。

entries.en: The ambassador's representational duties included welcoming visitors at official receptions.
entries.zh: 大使以代表身份履行的职责包括在官方招待会上迎接来宾。

entries.en: Her homemade lemonade was a sharp concoction of lemons, mint, and ginger.
entries.zh: 她自制的柠檬水混合了柠檬、薄荷和生姜，味道浓烈。

entries.en: An unoccupied chair near the window gave us somewhere to put the bags.
entries.zh: 窗边有把空椅子，我们可以把包放在那里。

entries.en: The potatoes were crispy outside and soft in the middle.
entries.zh: 这些土豆外面酥脆，里面绵软。

entries.en: Before I could finish, she interjected a question about the missing receipt.
entries.zh: 我还没说完，她就插话问起了丢失的收据。

entries.en: The campaign asked each major polluter to publish its annual emissions figures.
entries.zh: 这项行动要求各主要污染者公布年度排放数据。

entries.en: The cabinet's fine workmanship is visible in its carefully fitted joints.
entries.zh: 柜子各接合处严丝合缝，体现了精良的制作工艺。

entries.en: The brass doorknob felt cold when I turned it.
entries.zh: 我转动黄铜门把手时，感觉冰凉。

entries.en: She dropped a coin into the jukebox and chose an old love song.
entries.zh: 她往点唱机里投了一枚硬币，选了一首老情歌。

entries.en: The study found a connection between the events but did not establish causality.
entries.zh: 这项研究发现了事件之间的关联，但没有确立因果关系。

entries.en: We photographed the caterpillar's metamorphosis into a butterfly for our class project.
entries.zh: 我们为课堂项目拍下了毛毛虫蜕变成蝴蝶的过程。

entries.en: As a federalist, she favored sharing power between national and regional governments.
entries.zh: 作为联邦制支持者，她赞成中央政府与地区政府分享权力。

entries.en: The film shows a looter carrying furniture from an abandoned shop.
entries.zh: 电影中，一名趁乱抢掠者从弃置的商店里搬出家具。

entries.en: The teacher raised a hand to quieten the excited class.
entries.zh: 老师举起一只手，让兴奋的学生们安静下来。

entries.en: The exhibition explores how attitudes toward childbearing changed across three generations.
entries.zh: 这场展览探讨了三代人之间生育观念的变化。

entries.en: In the legend, the warrior raises his sword to smite the giant.
entries.zh: 传说中，勇士举剑重击巨人。

entries.en: The parched earth cracked beneath the abandoned orchard's remaining trees.
entries.zh: 荒废果园里剩下的树木脚下，干透的土地裂开了。

entries.en: Remove the woody ends of the asparagus before preparing the dish.
entries.zh: 做这道菜前，先去掉芦笋木质化的根部。

entries.en: The visitors laughed heartily when the guide imitated the stubborn donkey.
entries.zh: 向导模仿那头倔驴时，游客们开怀大笑。

entries.en: She absently stirred her cold coffee while studying the handwritten note.
entries.zh: 她看着那张手写便条，心不在焉地搅动冷咖啡。

entries.en: Someone anonymously donated enough books to fill the library's new shelves.
entries.zh: 有人匿名捐赠了足够多的书，放满了图书馆的新书架。

entries.en: His silence was mistaken for acquiescence, although he strongly opposed the plan.
entries.zh: 尽管他强烈反对该计划，他的沉默却被误认为默许。

entries.en: The editor used italic type for the titles of books.
entries.zh: 编辑用斜体字排印书名。

entries.en: The psychotherapist listened while he described the worries affecting his sleep.
entries.zh: 他讲述影响睡眠的烦恼时，心理治疗师认真倾听。

entries.en: Fatherhood changed the way he organized his time and planned his career.
entries.zh: 当父亲后，他安排时间和规划职业的方式都变了。

entries.en: The jury praised the film's groundbreaking use of hand-drawn and digital animation.
entries.zh: 评审团称赞这部电影开创性地结合了手绘动画和数字动画。

entries.en: The penthouse has a roof terrace overlooking the river.
entries.zh: 这套顶层豪华公寓有个可以俯瞰河流的屋顶露台。

entries.en: With its low beams and open fire, the cottage is an archetypal country retreat.
entries.zh: 低矮的横梁和开放式壁炉让这间小屋成为典型的乡间休憩处。

entries.en: His homemade contraption sorts coins using a series of sloping wooden channels.
entries.zh: 他自制的古怪装置利用一系列倾斜的木槽来分拣硬币。

entries.en: The old bridge creaked ominously as the loaded wagon rolled across.
entries.zh: 满载货物的马车驶过时，老桥发出了令人不安的嘎吱声。
